description:
Eliminate remaining duplicates of the Numerical-Recipes deterministic LCG (constants `6364136223846793005` and `1442695040888963407`) across the workspace. The modem path was consolidated in 51334873 onto `gf2_core::test_rng::Lcg`; four non-modem sites still carry their own copies and must be migrated before the modem story's code-review gate accepts the workspace as SSOT-clean.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] Promote `gf2_core::test_rng` to `gf2_core::rng` as a public module (deterministic LCG is legitimately useful outside tests — `fading.rs::generate_permutation` is production code).
- [ ] Migrate `crates/gf2-coding/src/fading.rs::generate_permutation` to call `gf2_core::rng::Lcg` while preserving bit-exact output (same seed → same permutation) so existing BER regression tests still pass.
- [ ] Migrate `crates/gf2-coding/src/gldpc/mod.rs` test RNG to `gf2_core::rng::Lcg`.
- [ ] Migrate `crates/gf2-core/src/gf2m/field.rs` test RNG (two sites at lines ~4943 and ~4984) to `gf2_core::rng::Lcg`.
- [ ] Migrate `crates/gf2-core/benches/gf2m_mul_strategies.rs::pseudo_random_element` to `gf2_core::rng::Lcg`.
- [ ] Update `gf2-coding::modem::test_oracle::Lcg` re-export path to point at the new public module.
- [ ] `grep -rn "6364136223846793005" crates/` returns only hits inside `gf2_core::rng`.
- [ ] Full test suite (`cargo test --workspace --all-features --release`) passes with no behavioral drift.

## Notes

Follow-up to 51334873. The modem-framework epic's code-review gate refuses to pass until the workspace-wide LCG SSOT finding is resolved, so this issue must complete before 51334873 can close.
title: Consolidate workspace deterministic-LCG helpers onto gf2_core::rng::Lcg
